description: This file contains backend API implementations and data structures for DNS diagnostic and NSLookup diagnostics within a COSA (CPE Operating System Abstraction) Data Model. It includes functions for getting and setting parameters, validation, commit, rollback, and result management for DNS diagnostics, specifically for NSLookup examinations, along with associated data handling and validation logic.

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_GetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL * pBool)
methods.description: Retrieves a Boolean parameter value for NSLookup diagnostics based on the parameter name.

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int * pInt)
methods.description: Retrieves an Integer parameter value for NSLookup diagnostics based on the parameter name.

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * puLong)
methods.description: Retrieves a ULONG parameter value for NSLookup diagnostics; handles specific parameters like DiagnosticsState, Timeout, NumberOfRepetitions, SuccessCount.

methods.name: ULONG NSLookupDiagnostics_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves string parameter values such as Interface, HostName, DNSServer for NSLookup diagnostics.

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_SetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL bValue)
methods.description: Sets a Boolean parameter value for NSLookup diagnostics (unsupported in current implementation).

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_SetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int iValue)
methods.description: Sets an integer parameter value for NSLookup diagnostics (unsupported in current implementation).

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_SetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG uValue)
methods.description: Sets a ULONG parameter value; handles DiagnosticsState, Timeout, NumberOfRepetitions, with specific logic for scheduling or canceling diagnostics.

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_SetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pString)
methods.description: Sets string parameters such as Interface, HostName, DNSServer with validation and potential cancellation of ongoing diagnostics.

methods.name: BOOL NSLookupDiagnostics_Validate(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * pReturnParamName,ULONG * puLength)
methods.description: Validates the parameters for NSLookup diagnostics before scheduling; checks Interface address, HostName syntax, DNS server address, Timeout, and Repetitions.

methods.name: ULONG NSLookupDiagnostics_Commit(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Commits the NSLookup diagnostic request, scheduling the diagnostic if requested.

methods.name: ULONG NSLookupDiagnostics_Rollback(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Rolls back any uncommitted changes, restoring previous diagnostic info state.

methods.name: ULONG Result_GetEntryCount(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Returns the number of diagnostic response results, if available.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE Result_GetEntry(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,ULONG nIndex,ULONG * pInsNumber)
methods.description: Retrieves a specific diagnostic result entry by index.

methods.name: BOOL Result_IsUpdated(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Checks whether the diagnostic result data has been updated since last check.

methods.name: ULONG Result_Synchronize(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext)
methods.description: Synchronizes the current diagnostic result information with the latest data from backend.

methods.name: BOOL Result_GetParamBoolValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,BOOL * pBool)
methods.description: Retrieves boolean parameters from diagnostic result entries (supports none currently).

methods.name: BOOL Result_GetParamIntValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,int * pInt)
methods.description: Retrieves integer parameters from diagnostic result entries (supports none currently).

methods.name: BOOL Result_GetParamUlongValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,ULONG * puLong)
methods.description: Retrieves ULONG parameters such as Status, AnswerType, ResponseTime from diagnostic results.

methods.name: ULONG Result_GetParamStringValue(ANSC_HANDLE hInsContext,char * ParamName,char * pValue,ULONG * pUlSize)
methods.description: Retrieves string parameters such as HostNameReturned, IPAddresses, DNSServerIP from a specific result entry.
